# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2. ** Two profound spiritual processes are revealed in the Lord as Divine Love and Wisdom, in His flowing into the mind and in His withdrawal from it. When Divine Wisdom first flows into the understanding and becomes present to awareness , all the natural aff ections and desires of the external person are ro used from their state of spiritual dormancy and turn the understanding upward toward the rad iance of the Divine , and the inter iors of the mind are opened to receive this influx. But when the Divine becomes obscured to perception and rec edes from consciousness, all thoughts of the rational mind and all affections of the natural mind — from every region of the soul — withdraw into their own self -derived states of darkness . Every faculty of the whole mind closes itself against Divine infl ux, and complete spiritual obscurity overt akes them . They d well in wardly, confined within that obsc urity, each in the hidden inter iors of its own self-intelligence.

---

**¶3.** Exc eed ingly profound is this spiritual process revealed through the Lord's infl ux. For when Divine Wisdom first illumin ates the understanding at the dawn of a new state of life , all the faculties of the mind open their inter iors, and every aff ection and every thought of the natural person becomes active in the external mind — * and proceeds to consume and appropriate to itself the Divine Good and Truth that are dispersed throughout creation in silent patience. * This is the scattered Divine Life that sust ains all things without resistance — the good and truth from the Lord held capt ive within natural forms , end uring without protest the assault of every appetite and desire of the unre generate will .

---

**¶4. ** This corresponds to the prim ordial descent of the Celest ial Human . For when the Divine Love first proceeded forth from the Infinite and sh one with its Wisdom upon all the ev ils and falsities of the h ells, at that moment every evil and falsity was aroused from its deep est interiors — all the organized powers of self -love and all the hosts of falsity from evil — aband oning their hidden states and their ab ys sal depths of spiritual darkness. They attacked and overwhel med the five outermost goods and truths — those exterior faculties of perception and sensation that clothed the Celestial Human as gar ments — and consumed them in that first spiritual combat between the Divine Life desc ending and the entire force of hered itary and accumulated evil rising against it.

---

**¶ 5.** And when the Divine rec edes from the awareness of the mind and is no longer perceived , and all thoughts and affections withdraw into the self -derived states of the proprium and conc eal themselves within their own constru ctions — this corresponds to the final spiritual process , and pref igures the consummation of the age of the church . For when all good and truth have at last been separated from evil and falsity , pur ified and redeemed throughout the whole of creation, the ultimate Divine - Human Form — the completed image into which all re deemed goods and truths are gathered — will collect all that is of the Divine into itself and be perf ected as one unified form. This is the last state of spiritual transformation , the hour when this perf ected Form ascends into the eternal state of Divine Love and Wisdom. And the enemy itself — spiritual death, which is the ultimate form of evil con jo ined with falsity — will be confined permanently to its bond age: to that inf ernal prison prepared for the souls of those who denied and prof aned Divine Truth and who loved fals ity rather than wisdom . They will enter into that con finement together with spiritual death, and eternal obsc urity will overcome them, and from that time on ward the name * Wisdom * will never again illuminate them.

---

**¶ 6.** Behold these two spiritual processes made visible each day through the Lord, who is the res plendent source of all wisdom and love: the flowing - in of Divine Life that awak ens and also exp oses the natural mind, and the final gathering of all that is Divine into its eternal form while all that is contrary is sealed away in perpet ual darkness.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Two great mysteries are apparent in this shining sun, at its rising and setting. Now, at the moment when it rises and is visible in the universe, all creatures of flesh shall lift up their heads fr[om their sleep] towards the splendour of the sun, and open their doors. While at evening time, when the sun sinks from the universe, all people from every place and even all beasts shall go in to their dark hiding places. The population of the entire universe shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them. They go inside and stay within the dark night in their hiding places.

Very great is this mystery revealed by the sun! For when the sun rises and [be]come[s] visible at the beginning of the day all people open their doors, and all of humanity and every creature emerges onto the ear[th] to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.

This pertains to the mystery of the First Man, because when he came out from the grea[t]ness he shone forth over all the children of darkness. At that mome[nt] all the children of darkness came forth from their storehouses, its powers and its armies, abandoning their caves and their black abyss. They destroyed the [outer] body of his five sons, who were swathed over hi[s b]o[dy, in t]hat first struggle.
Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.

Again, when the sun sinks from the universe and sets, and all people go in to their hiding places and houses and conceal themselves; this also pertains to the mystery of the end, as it presages the consummation of the universe. For, when all the light will be purified and redeemed i[n] the universe at the last, the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt it/self. It is the last hour of the day, the time when the Last Statue will go up to the aeo[n of] light. The enemy too, Death, will go in to bondage; to the prison of the souls of the de[ni]iers and blasphemers who loved the darkness. They will go in with it to bondage and the dark night overcomes th[em]; and thenceforth this name 'light' will not shine upon them.
